STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_203129.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_203129.v · Open raw
module origen_203129(
    input wire st_conv,
    output wire clkout,
    input wire clkin,
    output wire sample,
    output wire [11:0] result,
    output wire [11:0] dac_value,
    input wire comp_in,
    output wire adc_done,
    input wire rst
);

    localparam S_WAIT = 2'b00;
    localparam S_SAMPLE = 2'b01;
    localparam S_CONV = 2'b10;
    localparam S_DONE = 2'b11;

    reg [1:0] state;
    reg [11:0] steps [13:0];
    reg [11:0] dac_reg;
    reg [3:0] count;
    reg sample_reg;
    reg adc_done_reg;

    assign clkout = (state == S_CONV) ? clkin : 1'b0;
    assign sample = sample_reg;
    assign result = dac_reg;
    assign dac_value = steps[count];
    assign adc_done = adc_done_reg;

    initial begin
        state <= S_WAIT;
        dac_reg <= 12'b0;
        count <= 4'b0;
        sample_reg <= 1'b0;
        adc_done_reg <= 1'b0;
        steps[0] <= 12'h800;
        steps[1] <= 12'hc00;
        steps[2] <= 12'ha00;
        steps[3] <= 12'hb00;
        steps[4] <= 12'h980;
        steps[5] <= 12'ha80;
        steps[6] <= 12'hb80;
        steps[7] <= 12'ha40;
        steps[8] <= 12'hb40;
        steps[9] <= 12'ha60;
        steps[10] <= 12'hb60;
        steps[11] <= 12'ha50;
        steps[12] <= 12'hb50;
        steps[13] <= 12'ha58;
    end

    always @(posedge clkin or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            state <= S_WAIT;
            dac_reg <= 12'b0;
            count <= 4'b0;
            sample_reg <= 1'b0;
            adc_done_reg <= 1'b0;
        end
        else begin
            case (state)
                S_WAIT: begin
                    if (st_conv) begin
                        state <= S_SAMPLE;
                    end
                end
                S_SAMPLE: begin
                    sample_reg <= 1'b1;
                    state <= S_CONV;
                    count <= 4'b0;
                end
                S_CONV: begin
                    sample_reg <= 1'b0;
                    if (count == 4'd13) begin
                        state <= S_DONE;
                        adc_done_reg <= 1'b1;
                    end
                    else begin
                        if (comp_in) begin
                            dac_reg[11 - count] <= 1'b1;
                        end
                        else begin
                            dac_reg[11 - count] <= 1'b0;
                        end
                        count <= count + 1'b1;
                    end
                end
                S_DONE: begin
                    adc_done_reg <= 1'b1;
                    if (!st_conv) begin
                        state <= S_WAIT;
                        dac_reg <= 12'b0;
                        count <= 4'b0;
                        sample_reg <= 1'b0;
                        adc_done_reg <= 1'b0;
                    end
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
